candidates.change_summary: Change the return statement to return false instead of true.
Compute _value as v instead of v scaled by 10**_decimals, so each transferFrom moves a different amount.
Remove the revert on failed transferFrom calls, so failed transfers are silently ignored and the function still returns true.
Use the selector for transfer(address,uint256) instead of transferFrom(address,address,uint256), causing every call to fail and revert.
Change the loop bound to i < _tos.length - 1 so the last recipient never receives a transfer.
Change the return statement at the end of transfer to return false instead of true, so successful calls return a different boolean.
